list.name: test_id
list.label: Test ID
list.query: SELECT test_id FROM test_runs ORDER BY created_at DESC

options.content: **Jump to:** [01 Overview](/d/censprobe-01?var-test_id=${test_id}) · [02 Blocking Matrix](/d/censprobe-02?var-test_id=${test_id}) · [03 Telegram](/d/censprobe-03?var-test_id=${test_id}) · [04 Protocol Reachability](/d/censprobe-04?var-test_id=${test_id}) · [05 Technique Attribution](/d/censprobe-05?var-test_id=${test_id}) · [06 Compare Tests](/d/censprobe-06?var-test_id=${test_id}) · [07 Cloudflare & WARP](/d/censprobe-07?var-test_id=${test_id}) · [08 QUIC & ECH](/d/censprobe-08?var-test_id=${test_id}) · [09 DNS](/d/censprobe-09?var-test_id=${test_id}) · [10 TLS](/d/censprobe-10?var-test_id=${test_id}) · [11 Matrix Heatmap](/d/censprobe-11-matrix-heatmap?var-test_id=${test_id})

targets.rawSql: SELECT method, COUNT(*) AS detections FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs run ON run.id = tr.test_run_id WHERE run.test_id IN (${test_id:singlequote}) AND method IS NOT NULL GROUP BY method ORDER BY detections DESC

SELECT method, category, COUNT(*) AS affected FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs run ON run.id = tr.test_run_id WHERE run.test_id IN (${test_id:singlequote}) AND method IS NOT NULL GROUP BY method, category ORDER BY method, affected DESC

SELECT target, verdict, method, notes FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs run ON run.id = tr.test_run_id WHERE run.test_id IN (${test_id:singlequote}) AND category = 'dns' AND verdict NOT IN ('OK','INCONCLUSIVE') ORDER BY target

SELECT test, target, verdict, method, rtt_ms, elapsed_ms FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs run ON run.id = tr.test_run_id WHERE run.test_id IN (${test_id:singlequote}) AND category = 'throttling' ORDER BY verdict DESC

SELECT test, target, verdict, method, notes FROM test_results tr JOIN test_runs run ON run.id = tr.test_run_id WHERE run.test_id IN (${test_id:singlequote}) AND category = 'middlebox' AND verdict NOT IN ('OK','INCONCLUSIVE') ORDER BY verdict DESC, target
